summary.zh: 通过 Blender 插件让 Claude 查看和修改本机打开的 Blender 场景、执行 Blender Python。使用前请关闭 CMCP 内置的 Blender 组。
summary.en: Lets Claude inspect and change the scene in the Blender open on this computer and run Blender Python through its add-on. Turn off CMCP's built-in Blender group first.

manifest.name: MCP for Blender
manifest.description: ahujasid/blender-mcp: controls the open Blender through its add-on (port 9876).

requires.name: Blender
requires.hint: Install the MCP for Blender add-on from the project page and start its server in Blender

manifest.instructions: Uses the same Blender add-on port as CMCP's built-in Blender tools; keep only one of them on.
